admitted-retries.note: 1000 repeated release/cancel/projection reads; no provider sends or writes

blocked-retries.note: 1000 live handoff-gated retries preserve the shared hold and durable acceptance

cancelled-retries.note: 1000 repeated release/cancel/projection reads; no provider sends or writes

held-cancellation.note: One held job's durable cancellation before shared FIFO removal; no provider send

held-release.note: One explicit held retry through existing dispatch/identity/confirmation boundaries; acceptance and terminal excluded
